_comment: TDD M4 slice: per-route dialect override. Current Go build rejects explicit different dialect at --validate-config (milestone 4+); HTTP expectations below describe the contracted egress (provider-owned auth, dest-keyed URL/headers/classification). Translated (dest != ingress) consumes prompt_cache_key before codec.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chat]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "prov-chat-secret"
session_header = "x-affinity"
session_prompt_cache_key = true
[providers.chat.litellm_kwargs]
headers = { "X-Legacy" = "legacy-kh" }
extra_headers = { "X-Extra-Only" = "extra" }

[[models]]
name = "rd-ts"
provider = "chat"
model = "claude-haiku-4-5"
dialect = "anthropic"
name: m4_route_dialect_chat_default_anthropic_translated_affinity
